meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs a punch-in, punch-out, zoom, reframe, Ken Burns treatment, camera move, visual match/whip handoff, or other seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes; also for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加推拉缩放、运镜和转场关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想给视频片段添加电影感的推拉缩放和运镜动画
copy.tagline_en: Add punch-in, zoom, reframe, and camera-move keyframes to video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you edit video and want cinematic push-in, zoom, and camera-move animation

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 负责 HyperFrames 画面里的动作效果：拉近/推远、平移/重构图、遮罩裁剪等，并用检查工具和截图验证。剪辑素材、排时间轴和调音频由别的技能负责。
howto.when: 当你在 HyperFrames 项目里要求做推拉、缩放、Ken Burns 等画面动效，或处理 GSAP/CSS 等关键帧技术，以及运行 `hyperframes keyframes` 诊断时触发；不用于整片规划、品牌设计等。

say.text: 给这个开场画面做缓慢拉近的 Ken Burns 效果。
say.note: Claude 会添加平移/缩放关键帧并截图验证。

say.text: 把主体从画面左侧平移到右侧，大小不变。
say.note: 他会写平移关键帧，让同一个主体不跳变。

say.text: 让这个 Logo 的轮廓用描边动画画出来。
say.note: 他会给 SVG 配描边关键帧并运行检查。

howto.what_en: Claude writes visual keyframes inside a HyperFrames composition: punch-in/out, pan/reframe, crop/mask wipes, etc. It verifies them with CLI checks and screenshots. Timeline, clip assembly, and audio are handled by other skills.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a HyperFrames composition needs punch-in/out, zoom/reframe, Ken Burns, or similar visual motion; also for GSAP/CSS/Anime.js/WAAPI/FLIP keyframes, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics.

say_en.text: Give this opening shot a slow Ken Burns zoom-in.
say_en.note: It adds pan/zoom keyframes and verifies with screenshots.

say_en.text: Move the subject from left to right at the same size.
say_en.note: It writes pan keyframes on the same subject to avoid jumps.

say_en.text: Animate this logo's outline with an SVG stroke-draw effect.
say_en.note: It sets stroke keyframes and runs diagnostics.
